194601.overview: Captain drexx is a tower defence game that really shows what the little black box of delights can still do!

194602.overview: As every year, our chief proposes a motor race with which to implement our mechanical knowledge acquired at the garage. The prize is an extra payment. This time you did your homework and you built a car in your spare time that has nothing to envy to a F1! But the stages that you have to overcome have been located and designed to try the patience of the fastest drivers.

194617.overview: As famous seducer of XVIII century, Giacomo Casanova, you are walking on the streets of some town full of obsessed women and jealous men. Using your mandolin you should clean your way of the town inhabitants shooting the music notes at them. The amount of notes are limited as well as the amount of life and the amount of your life energy, which may be reduced by items thrown at you by town inhabitants. Lovely doves may increase your energy feeding you with eggs, which they drop during flying. Also you may climb the static chains and the ropes emerging from the magic pots, jump, and collect the brassieres increasing your score. Every contact with town inhabitant will take one of your lives out and return you to the starting position of your perilous adventure.

194623.overview:
A video adventure where we control Constantín, who wants to avenge the death of his beloved. We will have to enter a mysterious castle and solve the enigmas that await us there.

Under this classic premise, we are faced with a platform game and screen by screen exploration in which our character is endowed with an energy bar that will decrease as it rubs against enemies, or suffers the already omnipresent deadly drop, present in some passages.

194634.overview: Alejandro Nuñez. 25 years. Since you were 11 you started to be interested in adventure. That passion has finally paid off, as a map of an ancient civilization that lived in the forests has come into your hands. According to this map, this civilization had a temple where it hid great wealth. But it also says that there was a king who possessed a scepter with which he was capable of doing improbable things, such as giving his warriors immunity, or communicating with spirits. He also says that the temple is full of countless traps. Can you leave the comfort of civilization and venture into the Central American jungles in search of that scepter?

194644.overview:
Chemad is mad. The Gods of Metal play a gig tonight and the idea he had of printing out the wanking guitarist GIF so he could get it signed by the band hasn’t come out quite nicely. And if that was not enough, Badajoz’s seventh bio-dance group has organized a batukada festival in the neighbourhood, blocking the entrance to the concert hall.

Help Cheman collecting powwwer medallions while regaining control of the neighbourhood getting rid of all the unnerving batukadas. Don’t let a samba-reggae spoil a good riff!

194648.overview:
The Evil Witch Soraya, simply put, hated Cheril. Specially after she had gained her Goddess status (see previous game “Cheril the Goddess“), when Soraya cried in anger and envy for four days straight. She just couldn’t stand Cheril, and spent long sleepless nights thinking about something really awful to do to her. Finally, she conceived a truly evil plan.

Rigoberto Brioso was an incredibly beautiful wizard. She used to take long walks playing his lire along the paths in the gardens of his mansion, and stopped only to watch the sprinklers and let the birds come and land on his golden curls. That’s why Cheril accepted immediately when she received an invitation for a walk alongside the famous Wizard, listening to the beautiful sounds of mockingbirds and the chant of the unicorns. Or something.

Nevertheless, when she arrived to their date, she felt something was going incredibly wrong… She was in an old, decrepit, dark mansion and the handsome wizard prince was nowhere to be seen. Then she heard the evil laughter of Soraya:

– I’ve set a time bomb in each floor of this mansion, which will activate once you enter, so you better run unless you want yourself turned into a pile of pudding!

Cheril was immortal, but not invincible: a violent explosion would not kill her, but would tear her in pieces, and living in such a condition wasn’t a very nice perspective. So she decided to RUN for her “entireness”. But awe! All the chambers were locked! luckily, the mechanism was simple and all she had to do was push around the statues to make them fit in their pink bases. Simple, but time consuming. And time was scarce…

194651.overview:
This game is in Spanish so you probably won’t undestand a single word. But hey! Maybe it’s a good chance to learn!

Basically Cheril is in another forest and must talk with the characters in a specific order. Talk to Johnny Limite first. Each character will tell you who to talk to next. Also, collect the food.

194652.overview:
In the Badajoz jungle lives Cheril, a common girl, just like every other girl of her age. She eats cucumbers, hunts panthers with her bare teeth, flys around using hanging vines and dresses with suggestive animal furs. Nothing out of the blue. But Cheril, niece in second degree of Tartan, the scottish of the apes, has higher expectations. She’s fed up with Eleuterio, the ever serious monkey, which condemns her explosions of crazy and espontaneous youthness, with the lewd stares from Mondongo the aborigin and his cousin Mojinganga, and with those damned snakes which ambush her from behind every bush in the jungle. She want’s something better. She’s decided to go to the city and become part of the “beautiful people”, just like her ancestor Tarzán of the Apes, which went to London and wore a nice Tuxedo.

In fact, Cheril may leave whenever she’s arsed to go, but the journey is long: thirteen days on foot, so she needs to provide herself with enough food. She estimates that a giant nut a day will suffice, so that means that she needs to collect thirteen giant nuts before leaving. Go for it!

194653.overview:
Cheril, thanks to her strenght and intelligence, was able to say goodbye to her homeland, the jungle of Badajoz, travel accross the dusty paths full of monsters, and arrive to the big city. Nevertheless, she repented at once of her decision: the pharmaceutic enterprise “Parasol”, founded in the 60s by a couple of aberrating mad doctors, had developed a special virus which could make people incredibly beautiful and they decided to make their tests on the poor city inhabitants. The problem wasn’t the virus itself, which was awesomely well crafted and worked flawlessly, but the cistern truck which was used to transport it to the city: it was used to transport heavy morapio double-malt and wasn’t properly cleaned after that. And, of course, everybody knows that beautifier virus plus morapio double malt makes infected people to become stupid brain-eating zombies.

Cheril, completely unaware, arrived at the very same time the mayor of this town set up two enormous spiked boulders in the path which was used to enter and exit the city, after he had evacuated the very few “sane” inhabitants. When she realised, she was trapped inside. She wanted to exit the city, but the mayor wouldn’t remove the boulders while Zombies were still luring the city, so the only way for Cheril to escape from this doomed city is to slain the 60 zombies which walk around, so the mayor will remove the boulders and she can kiss this city goodbye!

194660.overview:
In the Temple of the Big Cucumber, Prince Chicken (who was famous for his studies of the arcane, for being a proud intelligent man and for having a foot slightly larger than the other), awaited a very special delivery: “arogas”, a sustance capable of increasing his inner power to a “Master of the Universe” level. With such power, he would be so strong that, only by thinking bad of somebody, he could make it explode. And that rocks big time.

Meanwhile, and thanks to having had so many adventures, Cheril had learned how to fly and throw energy balls made of concentrated “bad will”. There was a proble, thought: it took quite a lot of energy to produce such skills, so much that they ended draining her vitality! So, investigating in the slums of Little Olimpo (province of Badajoz), she learned about Prince Chicken and the delivery of arogas he was waiting.

So she was decided: she would sneak by all possible means inside the Temple of the Big Cucumber to intercept the delivery, so she could acquire such a big power for herself so flying and firing power balls wouldn’t drain her vitality. That way she could finally take over the work, and, specially, submit Eleuterio, the Very Serious Monkey, her nemesis.

To achieve such an objective, she learned she had to activate the three Sila-Tsikl elemental tri-force shrines by means of breaking them with the Sacred Talismans – such a thing would make the temple lock to appear so she could actually open it. Using the temple key, which she had to find as well.

So many things!

194673.overview: The game stands out especially for the originality of some of its screens and for the responsiveness of the controls, and it is very pleasant to play.

194704.overview: It’s a tough life being a chopper pilot. Day in, day out, you have to pick up crates and drop them onto the lorry ready for delivery. Time is short however, and you only get so long for each load. Don’t take too long or you’ll be fired.

194705.overview:
He raised from the Hell and sighed. On his face the wrath of a demon and the ambition of a thousand devils. He sprouted like a bad seed in the temple of Shaolin, whose walls lodged the best fighters of all times. The destiny has decided that the last hour for the good has arrived, because the yellow devil seized the original manuscript where Cheng Heung wrote the art of the Choy Lee Fut.

Supported on the force of the five magical animals, the speed and the technique of a good apprentice, we will cross the temple of Shaolin until finding the monster and recovering the scroll. We are an expert in punches, we handle the sabre with ferocity and make the flexible lance more penetrating and versatile. And all thanks to the Chi. As first action, we will have the possibility of training with the Dummies (the wood men), where we will practice the distance, the speed and the use of complementary techniques. From which we will get up ourselves into the dynamics of the fight and the confrontations hand-to-hand with the partisans of the evildoer.

The movements are varied, all of them based on the Kung-Fu techniques. With different arms we will be able to execute different movements using the same keys. Everything depends on the animal that our personage will adopt. The graphical theme also changes according to the fight scenes, including the face of the old man that observes us.

194707.overview: Chrimblast! isn't a very big game, coming in at only 8 levels, but what there is on offer is still a fun game to play to pass the time. It's also simplistic in design with asteroids and enemies appearing from the top that must either be avoided or blasted out of the way. But what I did really like about the game was being able to collect presents, listening to that voice over announcement and powering up the blaster to that of a much bigger beam, kind of like R-Type.

194708.overview:
SecuriCorp have been at the forefront of military technology. This fateful day there has been a major hack at the private outsource R&D company Revanox! Their Military Bio and AI research division has gone rogue! A hacker has inadvertently activated an uncontrollable AI and it's reeking havoc!! Highly sensitive security data is being lost to it and the fate of humankind is hanging in the balance!

In a last ditch attempt to save as much data as possible SecuriCorp are sending in their own rival AI...

Project Epsilon: Nan'O'Bot!

He will infiltrate the mainframe and rescue as much data as he can before Revanox rip the feed to the AI's power circuits!

GOOD HUNTING NAN'O'BOT!

194715.overview:
It is an adaptation of the arcade City Connection (Jaleco, 1985), which never had an official version for the system...

Back in 1986 or 1987, I was learning Assembler with the Machine Code course published by Microhobby. So I started to make a basic car game, with a horizontal scroll done in machine code. […] The game was left unfinished, and it was left there lost on tape. I then ditched the Spectrum, and didn't re-engage again until two or three years ago. After all this time, I no longer remembered this program that I left unfinished. About eleven months ago, rescuing old tapes I found one with several versions of a program called "car".

It is currently finished and includes many of the characteristics of the original.

194725.overview: Chichén Itzá is a Spanish text-adventure, the final chapter of the Ci-U-Than trilogy of games. They all utilize the parser DAAD, that has capabilities similar to the Infocom Z-machine one (you can chain commands, correct misspellings, etc). This time the main quest is divided in two parts: In the first half you have to satisfy all the gods demands while exploring the ruined temple and solving its mystery. In the last part you journey from hell to heaven in an effort to liberate the god Kukulkán from his prison.

194726.overview: Cobra's Arc is a curious conversational adventure in which the messages the computer send us play a fundamental role, but instead of replying to them directly, we must choose the action to do by pointing to the available icons of the actions menu, therefore this is what could be called an iconographic adventure. Also, you will find lots of places, personages and situations through the game, all of them surrounded in an atmosphere of fantasy and legend, so the action could take place in deserts, as well as inhospitable mountain ranges or mysterious walled cities. The plot of the game turns around a fabulous treasure, an immense amount of accumulated wealth during centuries by the priests of an old culture dedicated to the adoration of the god Cobra. According to the tradition, the temple where the priests jealously kept their jewels, diamonds and objects made with the most precious metals, was constructed on a ship, reason why it resisted the great deluge. Now the fortune hunters have as obsession finding at all costs the palace of the god Cobra. But for it, they will have to fulfill two objectives: killing the prince Cobra and the wizard; once they do it, they will be ready to find so incredible treasure.

194727.overview:
Meet Cocoa, the intrepid, accident prone, time-travelling Mini Lop Bunny, on his first adventure. Cast adrift through space and time, Cocoa's Time Burrow materialises in the 15th Century. With no fuel to get home...and desperately short of parsley to munch, Cocoa needs to use his skills and wits to refuel the Time Machine, recover valuable artefacts and satisfy his ferocious parsley craving.

Cocoa's Time Machine has transported his burrow to 1452AD, but he's used all his fuel in getting there.

He's on a mission to recover priceless artefacts for his collection, but is easily distracted by Parsley - his favourite food.  

So, find the artefacts, refuel the time machine, munch parsley, and get home in time for tea...

...if only it were that simple, his new timeline has recently suffered a pandemic, and panic buying has left the land short of many essentials. The King, for one, has a desperate problem...can Cocoa help?

194728.overview:
Having gathered enough fuel to return home from the middle ages in his first adventure (Cocoa and the Time Machine) Cocoa is in a quandary. 

With just enough fuel to travel 150 years in time Cocoa realises he is going to need the help of one of history's greatest inventors to help him build a better, more efficient and powerful drive for the Time Machine.

So, he sets the controls for 1899, Colorado Springs, USA as he goes in search of Nikola Tesla and his Experimental Station to enlist the help of the great inventor.

Unfortunately, he lands in the middle of a Meteor Storm, and the even bigger issue of Tesla's base being overrun by shadowy secret agents who are hell bent on stealing Tesla's inventions for their own, nefarious purposes.

But Tesla still has one trick up his sleeve, the Tesla Device, a handheld, multi-purpose gizmo that might just help. Cocoa has 24 hours to save the day and help Tesla defeat the secret agents, recover the stolen inventions and power up the Time Machine.

Join Cocoa in this epic story spanning three full Episodes crammed full of new tricks, puzzles and platform adventure...not to mention...PARSLEY!

Cocoa, Nikola Tesla and Kolman are...24 Hour Parsley People

194729.overview:
Complete each level of the game by flying and later landing on the platform with the pilot to be rescued, who will board your ship, and take him back to the station where you leave to consider the rescue successful.

Be careful of the dangers you will encounter, and pay attention to your fuel gauge. You will often have to collect the gasoline cans that you will find in some levels, or you will not be able to return to the base.

Some pilots have managed to get trapped behind huge doors. You will need to find the key first to be able to open them, and thus access the landing site.

The game consists of thirty levels spread over three different worlds. Try to complete them all!

194748.overview:
While the colonists work in the underground excavations of Mars, they are attacked by a Martian race.
Your mission is to climb to the surface of the planet and find the rescue vehicle to escape from Mars.
You will have to go through four levels before reaching the rescue vehicle.

194749.overview:
It is the conversion of a mobile game called Coloristic 2 and developed by Daniel Krautwurst. The goal is to move a pointer across a checkered board, trying to paint a set number of squares. We cannot retrace our steps or go through already painted squares, so the difficulty lies in finding the necessary moves to complete the squares without getting caught. Things get complicated later, as more complex colors and boards are added.

The conversion for ZX Spectrum is very successful, with a very elegant design, quite catchy 128k music and other details such as codes to continue the game from one of the 80 levels it incorporates.

194750.overview: Columns is a game in where you have to remove stones and get points so, in this way, you could beat the stone removing world record. It is based on the original by SEGA, a game that went down in history in the 90's; even more, nowadays they continue releasing new versions with new options but with the original idea: to remove gems in blocks of three or more.

194752.overview:
The program is a reinterpretation of the Epyx Chip's Challenge game, a rather vicious puzzle game.

The sound theme, excellent initial 48k music, and the theme of digitized voices plus other details such as the initial matrix effect or that of death.

194766.overview:
Complica DX is a board game you can play against the computer or another player,
featuring multicolor graphics, AY music and sophisticated A.I.

194767.overview:
Corrupt! is an interactive fiction game divided into 5 parts/chapters and framed within what in literary terms we would call a black novel.

In this way, the player takes the role of an FBI detective who must try to dismantle a powerful gang of drug traffickers, finding the evidences to stop the biggest suspect before the arrival of the next big shipment of cocaine.

In other order of things, it's necessary comment that, the game don't let the player save the game in course. To supply the lack of the save option, when the player will finish a chapter, the program will give a password that will let continue from that point.

194770.overview:
As the name indicates, Corsaires is a game focused on sea affairs, which consists of two independent parts. On the first one, you will be on a wild island, a place in which we will have to face endless hordes of pirates whose only obsession will be killing us. Some of them will use all kind of deadly weapons, such as the famous saber or a blunderbuss. Luckily for us and unfortunately for them, our protagonist is quite capable when it comes to fight with punches and kicks. So if all goes well, you will find a small boat which is awaiting you at the other extreme of the island. 
The second part, to which we can access without the need of finishing the first one, takes place in a pirate galleon. There we will have to represent the role of the hero once again and we should try to rescue the beautiful damsel. Now the game system is quite different from the first part, because we will be no longer able to directly blow our enemies, but we will have to use a sword to finish with all of them. The objective consists in ascending to the pirate flags which are in the different masts of the ship and, in the end, to arrive where the girl is before she ends being food for sharks.

194794.overview:
Load up this unique piece of software, type in your name, then sit back and watch the delightfully animated Christmas scene with an excellent medley of Christmas music as accompaniment.

That’s not all, just flip the cassette over and play the free game that comes with this first ever Computer Christmas Card.

SPACE COMMAND (Included game)
Your task is to guide and protect the Asteroid with its domed city through many star systems. You may encounter Alien life-forms whose orders are to seek and destroy you and the domed city.

The city is protected by a two stage force field whose energy banks become weaker after many impacts. The Defence Computer is programmed to automatically lower the force field to protect the populated areas only, leaving the rotating radar and communications dish open to alien attack. If it is hit you lose a life.

194823.overview:
The  two  Horaces  are  currently  helping  local  authorities  in  their  respective  countries  into investigating an underground network formed by their ancient enemies, the Guardians –an evil secret society bent on world domination –and the Spiders, together withtheir new allies, the Flying Demons.

One  day  US-Horace  (from  now  on  simply  Horace)  invites  his  cousin  for  a  holiday  in  the States  and  the  two  arrange  a  meeting  at  the  airport.  However,  the  plane  from  the  United Kingdom Horace was waiting for has arrived, but there is no sign of his relative.

All of a sudden, Horace receives a phone call on his mobile. “They got me, cousin! Help!” It is UK-Horace’s voice.  Another  voice –an  unknown,  eerie  one –intimates  Horace  to  head immediately for a place at the edgeof the city, otherwise his cousin won’t survive the day. Of course, he must go alone and not tell anyone about this.

Horace,  although  being  certain  he  is walking  straight  into  the lion’s  den,  complies  to  the request and stops his car in front of a tall, ominous building. He steps in...

194824.overview:
Pollution and its consequences make life on Earth impossible in a few years. It is then when governments come together to finance a plan to colonize outer space.

In this program of exterior colonization, a huge spaceship was created, a true continent that will transport different ecosystems, and some 5,000 brave humans, traveling through space until they find a new planet that is suitable to host terrestrial life.

Since Man has shown that he is not capable of taking care of himself, the control of the colony is under the command of a super computer, called Cray-5, which monitors that all the parameters are adequate so that all the species that travel within it can live safely throughout the journey, the final duration of which is unknown.

As lead designer of the Cray-5 processor, you didn't hesitate to volunteer to ride the ship, although the perfection of the processor makes it impossible to break down, you are fascinated by the mission objective.

194899.overview:
Cyberbig is an arcade-action game with very colorful graphics. The objective and mechanics of Cyberbig are quite simple (as much as the instructions of the game want us to believe otherwise): You are stranded with your robot on a planet full of gigantic monsters called Cyberbigs and other hostile inhabitants. The goal is to escape, running through one of the most gigantic maps in the history of 8-bit software.

To eliminate the "normal" hostile inhabitants you have to shoot them once with your laser, and when they are hit, they will shrink, at which time you'll have to crouch and shoot them again to finish them off. Cyberbigs are indestructible, so the only thing left is to run away when you come across one. In each sector you must recover discs that will help you escape. Putting them together will get you a tank and help you eliminate  enemies with just a single shot as well as blast doors to escape.

194908.overview:
In the 13th century the town of TRASMOZ was excommunicated for its pagan practices and its inhabitants were cursed for ever... The population was decimated until it became a ghost town, diseases and all sorts of evils on children, animals and crops made this an abandoned place left by the hand of God.

Until now no one had dared to approach TRASMOZ again, there is talk of dangerous creatures of the night, witches and living dead who protect the place run by the evil magician Mutamin: inmortal servant of the devil and master of the inaccessible castle and the watchtower.

But tonight is the night of the dead and the moon is full again The time has come as the prophecy says:

When the full moon crowns the night of all saints, a brave hero will break the curse for ever, he will sanctify the place with the fire of wandering souls, when they are liberated.

You are the hero chosen to fullfill this dangerous mission... Will you be able to release TRASMOZ from his curse before the sun rises again?

194961.overview:
Action game in which you change to different areas at set time intervals. Each area has a default character with different capabilities. After your time in an area is over you switch to the next area automatically. After cycling through all four areas you start again with the first one. The goal of the game is to get through all stages to the end.

The characters and abilities are (in order);
Ape, can jump forwards and hit objects (like stones statues) and enemies
Miner, can jump high straight upwards, and shoot
Gargoyle, can fly for short distances and shoot
Pilot, can jump and will come down slowly with a parachute, and can shoot
When you're in one of the four areas, you can change to a different character while staying in the same area. This gives you the ability to get around certain challenges. An example is a stone cross in the Gargoyle area of the game which can only be destroyed by the ape.

Switching between characters is done with the keys 1 through 4, and you can see how many lives each character has left in the four corners of the screen. Getting hit or being touched by enemies will drain the life of the character, and the picture in the corner of the screen will change into a skull, once it has changed completely into a skull you lose a life. Losing a character will not result in a game over, but may limit your abilities to progress in the game.

195339.overview: Custerds Quest is a humorous text adventure with graphics where you play the role of Sir Coward de Custerd, who needs to save the world from an evil necromancer. The game doesn't take itself very seriously and features tongue in cheek humor.

195525.overview:
Bomber (called City Bomber on the title screen) is a one-key arcade game, similar to Blitz.

You pilot a small airplane and your mission is to bomb the city so you can land safely. It is a one-key game, so you don't control the plane, you can only drop bombs by pressing the space bar. The plane moves from left to right across the screen, and slowly descends every time it wraps back to the left side.

At the start of the game you can choose a skill level from 1 (easiest) through 5 (hardest), and an entry wave, also 1 through 5. A higher skill level means the buildings are higher, thus more bombs are needed before you can land.

195585.overview: Set in the cold war, In The Code is a text adventure in which you are a secret agent who has to try to infiltrate a secret place in the KGB stronghold. Your mission, should you decide to accept it, is to go to a place deep within that stronghold from where no one has returned alive. We have only one message from your 25 predecessors. Cut short by a blood curdling scream. It said, "Nothing is what it appears to be and..."

195800.overview:
Compilation of three cartoon games on one disk:

DANGERMOUSE IN DOUBLE TROUBLE:
While relaxing in his Mayfair penthouse flat, DM receives a phone call from Colonel K, head of security. News has just arrived about Greenback's latest scheme. Greenback and his henchmen are in the process of building an android Danger Mouse.

YOGI BEAR:
Grim tidings from Jellystone Park, folks! Yogi's little pal Boo-Boo has been bearnapped by a mean hunter, planning to make some loot by selling him to a circus. Boo-Boo is locked in a cage near the hunter's cabin . . . somewhere in Jellystone. Only Boo-Boo's fearless and faithful friend Yogi can save him.

EVERYONE'S A WALLY:
Wally is back, this time with his family in the first ever Multi-Role Arcade Adventure.
The purpose of the game is to find the combination for the safe and then pay the gang's wages. The combination is split and can be found in different locations. Not only must the combinations be identified, but also the right items to collect the combination must be used.

195801.overview:
Cargo demonstrates the careful planning that is needed in loading a cargo ship to enable it to carry maximum cargo without risking the safety of the ship and crew.

The program shows how the Plimsoll line is used to show the limit to which a ship should be loaded. (Historical notes about the Plimsoll line are given in Background information.)

Cargo illustrates how the salinity (saltiness) of oceans and waterways affects how much cargo a ship can carry. This is shown on the Plimsoll line which has different marks for different kinds of water (see diagram).

The program demonstrates that storms and high seas are more frequent in certain areas than others, and the user must take account of these risks in order to make a safe journey.

In trying to load a ship safely, the user will see that it is important to consider the distribution of cargo in a ship. Overloading will cause a ship to sink, and bad distribution of load may lead to the ship capsizing.

Cargo helps users to understand the idea of density by showing that cargoes of the same size can have different masses (or 'weights').

195872.overview:
Mankind has established a distant colony, but the area is infested with ants, ladybirds and other parasites, all ready to cut through the perimeter fencing and eat your people's food. As a service droid it is your job to prevent this, and maximise the output.

Achieving this involves a lot of planning and resource management. There are several buildings at your disposal, containing seeds, solar panels, weaponry, fencing and traps. You must plant the seeds, use the solar panels to maximise their growth, and then harvest the finished product so as to trade it. You can carry a gun to take care of the bugs, but this needs recharging frequently, and the location of the munitions store must be determined.

When the bugs break part of the fence, you need to replace it to stop lots more coming through. This can be done more quickly by reducing the compound size, which causes the trade-off loss of growing room.

195990.overview: Sold as part of the compilation "Yankee", Chickamauga is a turn-based strategy game that takes the player in the middle of one of the deadliest battles of the American civil war, costing second-highest number of casualties in the real world. Can you do better?

196087.overview:
Camelot is a game based on the Arthurian legends where the player controls Arthur Pendragon after he has been banished from Camelot by the Black Knight. The objective is to collect seven items, unlock a secret door to the castle and be crowned king. This is done by acquiring an army of warriors and defeat various enemies (brigands, dragons, magicians etc.) in combat.

The game is played on a map where the player moves between countries. If a country is occupied by an enemy the player can choose to fight and if victorious it's possible to search for items. Battles are fought automatically and requires having enough warriors to defeat the enemy forces. All activities in the game also consume food based on the size of the army. Both food and warriors can be acquired with gold from bazaars. A healer that offers protection against plague can also be hired as well as a guide which allows the player to retreat from battle without losing warriors. The game is lost if the player runs out of warriors or food.

Once all items have been collected the player can return to Camelot. To open the secret door it's necessary to figure out the right key combination. It works similarly to Mastermind and the player gets three attempts. Finally, to complete the game the player needs to have enough money to repay a loan.

196758.overview: A network of stargates has been uncovered, potentially making instantaneous travel a reality. Aboard a newly designed starship, you must explore this galaxy and loot it. The ship is flown by using left and right to rotate, and up and down to change the height, as it moves at a constant speed. It drains energy as it goes, but this can be replenished by picking up the small pods. There are mines and meteors to avoid. On each section of the game you must find the next stargate and fly into it.

196764.overview: Championship Basketball Two-on-Two can be played as One or Two Player vs. the Computer or Two Player with Computer Teammates and includes Practice Play. Draft your Teammates from a list of ten players whose styles are patterned after real professional superstars. Practice with games like "Around the world" and "Horse", or go one-on-one with a friend. You play GBA Basketball on a full court. And when it comes to shooting, you have a full range of choices, like hook shots, tip-ins, jumpshots and even dunks. After each game, you can read the sports page of the Gamestar Gazette to check box scores and division standings.

197201.overview:
Scrabble De Luxe is the computer version of the classic word game Scrabble. It follows the official board game rules. It can be played at 8 different difficulty levels.

The main difference with Computer Scrabble is that the De Luxe version has enhanced graphics, a larger dictionary and a clock timer.

197327.overview: Gobbleman is a clone of the arcade game Pac-Man and has you attempting to clear a maze by eating all the dots while avoiding four ghosts. If you touch one of the ghosts then you lose one of three lives but there are power-pills that can be collected to let you eat the ghosts for a short time. The maze is viewed from above shown on the whole screen.

197499.overview:
Casino Royal features two gambling games: Roulette and Pontoon (blackjack).

Roulette is played by up to 6 people. When joining the table each player is given £500 worth in chips they must then use to place bets on the table, trying to predict which numbers will be produced by the roulette wheel.

Pontoon is played alone against the bank. The player starts with a capital of £100 and must aim, when adding the value of the cards in their hands, to get a count of 21, or as near as possible of 21, without going over.

Both games can take advantage of the Currah Microspeech extension to provide optional digitized sound effects.

197500.overview:
In this traditional baseball simulation, gameplay takes place mainly on a split screen.One side shows an overview of the field, the other showing the batter, with the latter view disappearing when the ball is hit.

The game requires you to "draft" a team before play, composing the best possible squad based on each player's skill attributes. The game also allows a semblance of managerial control, and has an optional batting practice mode to warm up. It then allows you to play individual games, or participate in a 4 division, 24-team championship.

197501.overview:
This adventure is set long ago when people still believed in magic, and anything out of the ordinary was said to be the work of faerie fold.  Any child that was different was thought to be a changeling, left by the faeries to fool the parents of a child they had stolen.

Your life is shattered when your only son falls desperately ill.  After consultation with the local wise man he is discovered to be a changeling, left there when your true son was stolen by the Tylwyth Teg, the faeries with a fascination for mortal children.  Your only hope is to go to the Crystal Isle, home of Gwyn-ap-nudd,  Lord of the underworld and King of the Faeries.  Unfortunately the way to the land has long since been lost to mortal man.

The wise man offers some hope though and tells you of an ancient tower, now deserted, but said to have once been the home of a mighty sorcerer. Legend says he left many magical things in the tower, including his great book of spells. Only there may you find the way to the land of Gwyn-ap-nudd. He tells you how to get into the tower but warns you that it guards its secrets well.

197504.overview: City of Death is a top-down RPG. The player controls a character named Swordbane. His objective is to find the wizard Bellatrix. He moves around in a big city, searching information about the wizard. He can buy weapons, food and spells, and can steal moneys from houses. Combat is turn based - the player can select target body's part (head, chest, body, legs and arms), or attacks blind. Game uses 4 keys to move: a-z (north-south) and x-c (west-east). Other commands like steal, buy or attack have a special key (displayed on screen).

197505.overview:
Claws of Despair is a traditional text adventure made using the Quill adventure generation software from Gilsoft with some graphics. You tell the game what you want to do via a textual interface and the parser is based on a verb / noun input.

You are the son of a noble house and the task at hand is to retrieve the Staff of Sarfrin for your king and people to save the land . You go into your quest with nothing but the star of Thorgrim to protect you, without which you will not be able to touch the staff you seek. The premise is a rather standard fantasy fare, along the way you will come across wizards and dragons and then must face the villain who guards the staff.

197507.overview: A secret message has been received, but the codebook needed to decode it is held by Lord Posh, who is a bit tipsy after a party and refuses to part with it. Your job is to obtain that codebook by bargaining with the party's guests and finding something valuable enough that Lord Posh will be willing to trade..

197508.overview: Colossus Chess 4 is a computer chess game. The game is customisable and you can monitor all your previous moves. It is even possible to see the computer thinking ahead and predicting your moves. The computer is hard to beat, and would win matches against other computer chess programs of the day. It can achieve the king-bishop-knight mate, which is the most difficult checkmate maneuver possible in Chess.

197509.overview:
Command Performance is a collection of ten games:

Mercenary
Hardball
Armageddon Man
Leviathan
Bobsleigh
Shackled
Trantor
Cholo
Xeno
10th Frame

197580.overview:
Confrontation is a two-player wargame between blue and red forces.

The game is slown on a static map. The player controls the following units in the game: tanks, mechanized infantry, engineer, flak, anti-tanks, scout, infantry, artillery, paratroops, fighter plane, ground attack plane, transport plane. Each of them have different abilities and can perform unique tasks. Fuel is exhausted in planes, and air units require airfield on the map to start from. Terrain effects are also taken into account for unit's action.

There is one scenario provided with master program, which is set in a modern European theatre of war with two countries seeking to control the lowland and cities between the rivers. The scenario provides for both land and air forces, together with paratroopers. The suggested objective is that the winner should be the first player to control cities.

It is possible to change the forces available to each side. However, neither side may have more than 35 units. An in-game editor allows maps to be created and edited.

197581.overview:
This add-on pack includes four scenarios for the original Confrontation game and requires it to be used with. These scenarios represent actual 20th Century conflicts:

- Afghanistan - Soviet column attempting to force a passage through the mountain passes

- Angola - South-African Unita defends coastal strong-points against Cuban-trained forces

- Sinai - Egypt vs Israel across the Sinai desert

- Kent - alternative history with German invasion of Kent in 1940

197582.overview: Corn Cropper is a simulation game where the player has to run a wheat farm profitably. The objective is to increase assets to £500,000 in 50 to 75 weeks (depending on difficulty). The game is text based and played by entering commands. Electron and 48 KB Spectrum versions add some graphics such as a map of the farm and weather forecasts. Commands are entered weekly (monthly in some versions). For each week three decisions can be made. Possible options include buying land, seeds, tractors and harvesters, hiring labourers, planting seeds, fertilising, harvesting, irrigating, spraying against insects and selling crops. Problems that might be encountered include drought, insect attacks and rats eating seed corn.

197583.overview:
Cosmic Debris is an archetypal clone of Asteroids.

The player controls a spacecraft in the middle of an alien asteroid belt and must destroy all the asteroids to survive. The asteroids start off large and when you shoot one then it splits into multiple smaller asteroids, each of which are destroyed in one shot and new asteroids appear perpetually. Occasionally alien space ships appear that can be shot for points.
You can rotate your ship 360 degrees as well as thrust forward and hyperspace into a random location on screen in a pinch. If you are hit by an asteroid or by shrapnel from a destroyed asteroid, then you lose a life. The game speed can selected, fast and suicidal. An extra live is awarded every 10,000 points.

197584.overview:
Cosmic Guerilla is an imitation and a non official version of the arcade Cosmic Guerilla. Similarly, the player controls a spaceship and has to defend his stationary fleet from being destroyed. The fleet is located on the centre of the screen and is aligned vertically, surrounded laterally by two vertical matrices of shields.

There are also present many sets of attackers which are aligned vertically and distributed on both right and left sides of the matrices of shields which are protecting the fleet. These attackers won't fire at none of the player's ships nor at the spaceship the player is commanding, instead they'll try to horizontally take the shields one by one until a spaceship is finally exposed. If a spaceship is taken by an alien, the player looses one life. If the player selects the "Alien Ships" option at the "Game Option" menu, sporadically a flying disc will fly at a very low altitude constantly bombarding the ground. If the playable spaceship is exposed to this bombardment one of the fleet's is immediately lost.

197614.overview:
Crete 1941 is a wargame recreating operation Merkur, at that time the biggest airborne invasion, conducted by German paratroops (Fallschirmjäger) during the World War II. The player may also control Allied forces (Greek, British, Australian and New Zealand troops).

After the deployment phase the game lasts 28 turns: from the morning of 20th May to the night of 27th May 1941. There are options to make the game easier: wind drift affecting drop accuracy can be turned off, Allies may fail to intercept German supply convoys. The units consist of infantry, engineers, artillery, anti-tank and anti-aircraft guns (the latter effective against landing paratroops/gliders). They're characterized by morale, experience and cohesion (integrity, of special importance to paratroopers spread after the landing). Additionally, the German side has air support (recon, airstrikes), while the British field tanks. The (mostly hilly) terrain affects combat losses. The game takes into account (score) the historical evacuation of Allied forces.

197615.overview:
HOTFOOT
A small rabbit has just woken from a winter's hibernation.  He yawns, stretches
himself, and sticks a little grey nose out of his burrow to sniff the fresh air of spring. Meanwhile, in the countryside around, thin hunger-crazed foxes are 
roaming.  They have just spent the entire winter trying to find the rabbit's burrow, without success!  But they also have noticed spring in the air, and know that very soon the rabbit will come scampering out in search of carrots. What the foxes don't know is that this time you are there to help the rabbit eat the carrots and then get back to his burrow safely - at least that's what you told the rabbit!


CREVASSE
The long hard winter on the polar ice-cap is finally ending.  You receive news that your supply ship has anchored, and, looking forward to seeing another human being for the first time in months, you jump into your ice-buggy and head off across the frozen wastes towards it.   But spring is warmer than ever before.  The pack-ice starts shifting beneath you.  On all sides chasms groan open, and then as quickly as they came, they grind shut.  One false move and you will disappear into the ice forever......

197638.overview:
The Refuge Assurance English county cricket championship provides the basis of this managerial recreation of the sport. Options are selected using nested text-based windows.

The range of options you have is similar to football management games; select your team of 11 from an initial squad of 16, based on their batting and bowling skills. New players can be brought in for money.

During the match, you choose the bowlers for each over, and the fielding positions, although bowlers are not divided into fast/medium/spin, so you will not find yourself altering these too often. Matches involve a single innings of unlimited length.

197639.overview: Cromwell at War 1642-1645 is a war strategy game for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum. It was developed by David Stokes and published by CCS in 1991.

197640.overview:
Only one person can remove the curse and return you to your former self. He is Albanon the Seer; but he left the city years ago to wander the Yaan Wilds in search of the true
way.  Can you locate Albanon and ask him for his help before you lose the power of speech for ever? Will you be able to pay his price?

197641.overview:
The Crystal Frog is a single player text adventure.

"I am in a small clearing in a field. There is nothing in the immediate area but grass all around. I can hear the birds singing in the summer sunshine, together with the fresh country air."

Thus starts the game, plunging the player straight into a text adventure where the object is to explore this land, find the eponymous Crystal Frog, and return with it. The player's progress is measured as a percentage score and the maximum possible score of 100% can only be achieved by visiting every location and using specific objects.

197642.overview: Cubey is a clone of the classic 3D platformer Q*Bert. This versuib was developed by Steve Catell and published by Chad Software in 1984.

197643.overview:
Welcome to this version of 8-ball pool. After picking the number of players (1 or 2), number of frames (1,3,5,7 or 9), colour of the table and if playing the computer, your opponent. Enter your name(s) and it's time for a game. The table is viewed from above and takes up the majority of the screen. At the top of the screen are a few options. Line up the shot, spin, strength of shot and reset the game. Occasionally a man with a big nose appears to update you on your game and a small man appears over the pocket the computer is aiming for.

Released on the Spectrum as part of the "Supersports Challenge" compilation.

197723.overview:
After much delay and name changes (Commando '86 and Commando '87), this game was ultimately published on the 6-Pak compilation as Duet.

Choose your tactics. Either go it alone and rely on your stealth and cunning to penetrate enemy territory or be part of a human machine - a crack Commando pair where survival means co-operation and teamwork. Whatever your method, the brief remains the same - collect vital documents from each area and return safely. The task is not an easy one. With minefields to avoid, tanks and foot patrols to out maneuver, the odds are heavily against you. So grit your teeth and prepare for combat!

198255.overview: A graphic role playing adventure game purchased by CRL from a freelance programmer, who it turned out had taken most of the code from the Argus Press release of The Valley. Argus sued and won a substantial settlement, while CRL removed the game from their offerings.

198260.overview: A flight simulator where you need to take off, stabilize yourself at 3000M then activate your ILS. Change to the frequency to allow you to request your landing. You can then monitor your developments on the left RADAR as long as you stay within 23km from the base and less than 3kM altitude. Remember to land o the right side of the runway!

199629.overview:
The object of the game is to destroy the caterpillar as it weaves its ways through the mushroom field. There are many other creatures to help the caterpillar reach the players area and destroy you. When the player has been killed all the partly shot and poisoned mushrooms are rebuilt and the player receives one point for each.  The creatures are removed and if the player has any bases left, then the caterpillar starts again at the top of the screen with all the shot segments rebuilt. The number of bases remaining are displayed at the top of the screen.

If the player destroys all the segments, the game continues with another caterpillar entering the top of the screen.  Each new wave will have half a caterpillar added up to a maximum of three caterpillars.

200332.overview:
For a long time, in a quiet town, people have not stopped disappearing. The last case being a young girl. The inhabitants think that the disappearances may be related to the new social engineering research center that they have installed in the north of the quiet town. Many have tried to enter to see what is cooking there, but no one has returned to tell the tale.

Sami, is the brother of the last case, a young girl of 6 years. Despite the obvious risk he will not give up and will enter that fearsome center to return to his sister, safe and sound.

201188.overview: Released on the Sinclair User Magazine issue 112: Twelve Pack

201189.overview:
The aim of the game is to collect all the keys on the screen avoiding enemies, spikes and platform jumping death falls. Egghead can only progress to the next level once all objects are picked up. The game contains a total of 40 screens. Egghead has only four lives. Time is limited too.

Released on the Crash Magazine issue 73: Presents 9 Covertape.

201192.overview:
A short demonstration of Magicland Dizzy that explains how Dizzy found his way to Magicland. It consists of a series of five screens (and one non-interactive screen). The objective is to repair the broken generator for the teleportation machine. Only a few items and one NPC are available.

Released on the Crash Magazine issue 84: Presents 20 Covertape.

201282.overview: The Charm is a retro platformer in which you play as Sir Oup, a Knight of the kingdom who is on a quest to break the evil that has taken over the land. It won't be easy though as many strange creatures, spikes and nasty traps will try to block your quest, yet that's what adds to the fun of this game. Your little guy can jump, duck, shoot his way through the levels and pick up items to solve puzzles all in a fantastic game of great retro detail of which there is plenty of. From waterfalls, to the platform landscape, this is a high quality game indeed, so well worth playing!

201285.overview: Catacombs of Balachor is a fairly simple flick screen arcade maze adventure that seem to take Ultimate's SabreWulf or AticAtak as inspiration. Rather than having any weapon, the hero has to avoid baddies and progress through the Catacombs collecting treasure, to finally escape. Although nominally a maze it differs from the Ultimate offerings mentioned in that progression is fairly linear – it is hard to get lost, and locked gates prevent you from backtracking too far. These are not criticisms, and some players will relish the face that navigating the dungeon is not too taxing. There are locked gates which require collected keys, and some parts later that require axes to progress etc., but most players will strip-search the rooms, so the ‘collection’ and managing the right tools to progress becomes secondary to just avoiding the baddies and collecting everything. A few hidden rooms spice things up, but they are easy enough to spot, if you search carefully.

202915.overview:
The 2017 ZX Spectrum game, Crystal Kingdom Dizzy is a stunning remake of the 1992 original, featuring updated graphics running in a 50fps engine, six new 128K tunes and a superb loading screen. 
* Programmed by Evgeniy Barskiy
* In-game graphics by Dmitri Ponomarjov
* GUI design & menu pictures by Oleg Origin
* Music covered by Sergey Kosov
* Title picture by Marco Antonio del Campo

The magical crystal treasure has been stolen and scattered all over the islands, so it is up to Dizzy to find them and restore order. Once again, Dizzy's main enemy is the pirates, and some deadly island creatures, but all Dizzy's friends are around to help out when the going gets tough.

202968.overview: Again a platformer, you are on a mighty rescue mission to rescue the Dream Fairies who have been kidnapped by an evil mouse king and his menacing acolytes.

203105.overview:
Space Invaders takes a slight twist, as rather than staying in formation, the aliens can now swoop down on you, making life that bit more difficult. Unfortunately, several of them have a go at the same time, leaving you with little room to maneuver out of a hail of bullets. There is one useful facility, in that the bullets you fire align themselves as you move the ship left and right. 

Inspired by Galaxian.

203472.overview:
Cheese is a simple game in which  you play a cat that has to protect a piece of cheese from a bunch of hungry mice. This was developed by Leon Goodfriend and released as a type in listing in an issue of Personal Computer Games magazine in 1983. 

It was also released in the compilation: Best of PCW - Software for the Spectrum, also in the same year by Century Software.

203522.overview:
Cheese Thief is a simple shoot 'em up aimed at kids. The goal of the game is to use the number keys on the keyboard to move the player's tank left and right as well as firing your cannon to kill the mice before it takes the cheese and brings it back to his "mouse hole". You have five "lives" or cheeses altogether.

This was developed by Mark Adams and Stephen Smith and published in Sinclair Programs - type-in from magazine issue #25 - 1984/Nov.

203969.overview: Colossal Adventure takes its cue from the very earliest mainframe text adventures. Our hero must rescue the elves and find fifteen pieces of treasure. There are many dark areas, so lights and batteries are at a premium. Be careful of vicious dwarves, who can be killed using axes. You can carry up to four objects at a time; the useful ones include a newspaper, keys and sandwiches. The vocabulary includes saying spell names, DROPping items to stay within the carrying limit (and for other specific reasons), CATCHing a bird, and standard directions plus IN and OUT.

204901.overview:
Not to be confused with the Amstrad CPC game of the same name (which is a platformer) Custard Pie for the ZX Spectrum is a word game similar to Hangman originally designed for the 16K Spectrum.

This game was developed by Michael Slive and published as a type-in listing in 16/48 Tape Magazine (UK) - within e-magazine "16/48 Magazine Tape 17" in 1985.

Instead of a traditional hangman character, the player "plays" a clown in which you have to guess the word before your face gets covered in a pie.

206035.overview:
In this interesting take on the "Pac-Man" genre, you are a taxi driver. The goal of the game is to go around the maze and collect passengers and to bring them to their desired location, and earn yourself some money. Watch out for the other cars, as they drive recklessly.

Cabman was developed by Alan Butcher and published by Micro Power in 1983.

207807.overview: Crusaders Mission Adventure is an RPG / adventure that seems to have elements that set it apart from other similar games. In it you are a missionary in a land inhabited by 3 tribes, each with its own distinct culture. Your task is to get to know the people and help them to make a religious connection with Christianity. Your time and money is limited, so use it wisely. As in real life, you will likely need a notebook, a journal and a set of scriptures. Additionally persistence and bravery will come into play.

208129.overview:
Created for the Yandex Retro Game Battle 2020, this a bouncing ball game with great 3D graphics. 

After centuries of war and suffering, peace slowly began to return to the world. Just as civilization had started to recover, however, another crisis fell upon it - an extra-terrestrial armada pillaged the earth, taking with them virtually all of the known supplies of gold. Society was plunged into chaos - financial markets experienced a recession of unparalleled proportions, electronics production ceased altogether...

An international task force was created with the aim of recovering the gold. Scraping together what they could with the miniscule amount that had not been plundered, a shuttle was constructed that would serve justice upon the invaders. It contained a few spherical exploration pods, which would navigate the planetary surface by means of bouncing upon it.

213372.overview:
Help Combat Wombat in his battle against evil! Guide him through each scene, defeating Crossley Hill High School bully Buzzer Boyd, and collecting bowls of Angel Delight for extra points. Once you have completed one loop of the game, you will start again only now The Fugue will also try to attack Combat Wombat. Each loop adds another Fugue demon to the screen.

Combat Wombat started as a fictional game in Dan Whitehead's graphic novel "Hexloader". It was created later and released as a freebie to the book.

213450.overview: Fifty previously-unreleased games make up this cheap compilation, making for 270K of data on the cassette, perhaps the highest tally ever. All written in BASIC, most are versions of simple arcade games, including Breakout, Pacman (Muncher) and Frogger. Sports are also well represented, with basketball, motor racing and bowls amongst others included. There's also a strategic Star Trek game, Pinball, and Tanks, and Motorway is perhaps the first game in which running over pedestrians is the objective.

213739.overview:
A celebration cut short after leaving the moon a  tad too fast in his last quest, then being caught by the moon patrol cops who claimed he broke the sound barrier, twice! The shockwaves and noise caused major ripples across the moon, much to the annoyance of its inhabitants.
As punishment, Moritz ended up with three points on his space driving licence and sentenced to do community work, which entails collecting all the mildewed chees from the surface of the moon. It's a stinky job and a lesson learnt but will Moritz cope to the very end or has he to go to jail?

215778.overview: The player controls a young warrior who has to find 6 diamonds and then return to the beginning of his journey. However, the diamonds are locked in the bricks, so you have to find the key to each chest first. Along the way, he meets various enemies with whom he fights karate style. Among the enemies will appear, for example, a brejlovic, a ninja or a fighter with a stick. Enemy placement is random, so every game is different. After the player has brought the diamonds to the destination, the path to the castle opens, where he must obtain the amulet and then fight his way to freedom.

217088.overview: Compendiums have been around for a long time. Few Christmas'went by without one turning up amongst the presents They usually looked cheap and were played with a few times and then put m a cupboard and forgotten about. Now you can play some of those old games in a slightly modified form on your computer. Up to four people can take part in the game with each player being represented by a member of the Wink family There are four games in the box: Ludo, Snakes and Hazards, Shove-a-Sledge and Tiddly Drinks. Ludo and Snakes and Hazards are the standard games with only minor differences. In both games the pieces used are Ralph. Victoria, Tiny Tim and Sniffer. The differences being that if you bump into one of other any other character on the board your turn will end and the next players begins. In Snakes and Hazards there are also some objects that stop your movement because your piece likes it, Sniffer the dog likes lampposts and bones for example. In Shove-a-Sledge you push Tiny Tim on a sledge and try to make him stop in each of ten different zones in the snow. The first player to stop him in all ten zones wins the game. In Tiddly Drinks the family is in the local pub. Dad is out on a drinking spree and you have to catch the glasses that he throws into the air - after draining them of the contents. The winner is the one that caught most glasses by closing time.

217295.overview: After a fine title card, a large, traditional darts' board appears. By pressing any key you freeze a fast moving sweep line, which determines the segment your dart has hit. At the base is a cross section through the board showing the rings - double, single, treble, single, outer bull, bull. It's elegant, simple and very effective. A sensible demo/instruction mode shows you how to do it. You can select the number of points required for a game, enter the two players' names, and the program guides you through three shots in each turn. You must finish with a double or bull of course.

418263.overview:
From the diary of Professor Abraham Van Helsing:

"I stand before the dark gates of Count Dracula's castle, with my gold cross in hand and determination in my heart. My mission is to find and destroy the succubi that infest this place before the Count returns from his nightly hunt for new victims.

 I have no stakes, so I'll have to search for them throughout the castle. But I'm certain I can find everything I need to accomplish my task. With my gold cross in hand, I'll move through the dark corridors and sinister rooms, facing the cursed demons that serve their master. I must find the coffins that house the succubi and drive wooden stakes into their hearts to end their reign of terror. 

The garlic cloves will help me to keep evil away from me. I also have to defeat the cursed demons that serve Dracula and roam the entire castle. 

To escape this place, I have to find the opposite drawbridge from the one I entered and break the curse that prevents me from escaping. I can only flee once I've defeated all the succubi, obtained all the garlic cloves, and destroyed all the cursed demons.

I know the task won't be easy, but I'm willing to face any danger to complete my mission. I must be cunning and brave, and not let fear stop me. Time is short, Count Dracula could return at any moment, but I'm determined to succeed in this dangerous adventure and leave this place alive".

423837.overview:
Chromanoids is a colorful maze and chase game, with 28 levels (divided into 4 worlds), 6 types of enemies, and 4 different melodies.

In each level you must eliminate a certain number of aliens by matching Oozi's color with the color of his enemies.

In most levels a red chili will appear, when Oozi devours it, it will turn into fire and will be able to eliminate any enemy regardless of its color.

424134.overview: In a dark and hidden place, hidden between imposing mountains and dense forests, lie the secrets of a silent village that pulses with terror. Its people, shrouded in an oppressive mystery, live immersed in the constant fear that has taken over their lives. Every alley, every corner, whispers macabre stories that would shake even the bravest heart.

442170.overview:
In a Star Trek-style future, a serum to be created from three Crystals located in far-off lands is required to save humanity. Only the USS Spectrum and its brave captain (you) can do this. Unfortunately, the ship's warp drive is malfunctioning and will soon be useless, so you must quickly get to the engine room and direct yourself into a distant galaxy using the co-ordinate system. Once there you will encounter aliens and robots, and must visit some of these hostile planets. 

Kill foes, navigate planets and use switches in the QUILLed adventure using VERB NOUN input.

444280.overview:
Welcome to our tribute to the expressionistic master piece from Robert Wiene: "Das Cabinet des Dr. Caligari".

A fair comes to town: You are 'Cesare The Somnambule', who is the big attracion of  the show. The illustrious Dr. Caligari is the one who controls your life (awake and asleep). You want to escape from this constant nightmare and break the  hypnotic influence of the evil doctor.

You will start in a room within the Asylum. Try to stay awake and find a way to escape. Next find the newspaper to get updated and follow your plan to expose Dr. Caligari to the authorities. Don't fall asleep or you will be lost forever!

Navigate through the woods! This is not that easy as the mysterious forest pathways change between day and night. Can you escape the evil?

Follow the voice in Cesare's head, his thoughts are displayed and will guide you through the game (Press 'L' to display Cesare's latest thought!).

The are two ways to solve the game, means there are two different endings! Which one will you chose?

448238.overview: Your job is to operate the Pithead winding gear at the colliery, lifting coaltubs to the surface and shunting them into a siding. Only the red tubs are useful and if you miss too many the mine will get choked up with them and don't smash them into each other when shunting!

448619.overview: Vountdown is a game based on a long-running Channel 4 TV show. It is a words-and-numbers game, following the original format of 6 letters games, 2 numbers games, and a conundrum. The game requires two players as there is no computer opponent.

449574.overview:
Classic Arcadia Collection is a compilation of three budget release clones of coin-op arcade games. The games in this compilation are

Classic Muncher, a Pac-Man clone
Classic Axiens, a Galaxian clone
Classic Invaders, a Space Invader clone

450788.overview:
"Conflict Command" is a classic military-themed video game compilation released for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum in 1988. Published by the legendary Ocean Software Ltd, the package bundled several high-profile action and arcade titles onto a single release.

The compilation featured a strong lineup of popular side-scrolling and military shooters.

Green Beret: A brutal, fast-paced side-scrolling military action conversion originally by Imagine Software.

Army Moves: A multi-stage arcade shooter originally developed by Spain's Dinamic Software.

Psycho Soldier: An advanced arcade coin-op conversion originally from SNK.

451122.overview:
The Crypt is a single player adventure game in which the player explores a series of dungeons collecting treasure and battling monsters.

The game is entirely controlled via the keyboard and has six levels, each level protected by a password. The objective of the game is to locate the Sacred Crucifix and return to the first room. The password for the first level is supplied both within the game and in the documentation, the password for the level two is supplied at the end of the first and so on.

In each room in the crypt is a monster which must be disposed of. Once the monster is dead the player's sword becomes useless and must be disposed of, additionally, Satan is none too pleased at having his minions slaughtered and sends fire bolts to avenge them.

When travelling between rooms in the crypt the game may take the player into the Blood Cell Attack phase. Here diseased bats descend from numbered positions at the top of the screen and the player must defend themselves against their attack by pressing the appropriately number key.

451133.overview:
City is a real-time better-than-a-board-game in which the Spectrum keeps track of the money and properties - and acts as a timekeeper - while the City you build takes on a life of its own. 

This City has banks, factories, houses, apartment blocks, shops and pubs. Four property developers struggle for rents and profits - building, purchasing and demolishing their way to one million pounds. But life isn't that simple because
in City you have to pay taxes - and the banks charge interest on overdrafts too! When people start to move about and property values alter you'll really be glad that the Spectrum is keeping track of everything while you just play the game.

For 1-4 players.

451173.overview:
Caesar's Travels is a game mainly for children age three to nine, and starts off where Caesar the Cat left off. After being kicked out by Mr. McGregor, his owner, for smashing too much crockery in the kitchen pantry, in an effort to catch mice, Caesar is placed in the yard and must find another home to go to.

Throughout the game, a series of choices appear and one must be selected with the function keys. The story being told varies depending on what choice the player makes. For example, the player may choose to climb the fence or jump onto the wall, or climb a mountain or walk along a path.

More often than not, Caesar is faced with a problem-solving question that usually requires the player to count the total number of items on the screen, and what object can they see on screen. There are 38 routes through the game and 18 different endings, all happy and non-violent - a point in the game's favor.

451196.overview: Computer Classics is a compilation of five games:Into The Eagles Nest Dynamite DanAliens Cauldron IIExolon (ZX Spectrum only) Zynaps (Amstrad CPC / Commodore 64 only)

451224.overview:
Gremlin action, platform and racing games compilation.

Platform games:* Cloud Kingdoms (Commodore 64/128 only)

Shadow of the Beast (Spectrum/Amstrad only)
Impossamole
Ghouls 'N Ghosts
Racing games:* Lotus Esprit Turbo Challenge

Supercars

451291.overview:
This Compilation Includes
CJ's Elephant Antics (1991)
Dizzy: The Ultimate Cartoon Adventure (1987)
Seymour Goes to Hollywood (1991)
Slightly Magic (1991)
Spike in Transilvania (1991)

451292.overview:
Mediterranean Europe is divided into grid squares.  Your aim, as Emperor, is to gain 100 squares of territory as quickly as possible - but at the same time you have to deal with Barbarian counter-attacks on your flanks, which are vulnerable.

For each 5 squares you cover, you are awarded a further legion (maximum 16) to help you in your battle.

The computer directs the Barbarian attacks - and at higher levels you'll have to take on rival Emperors with exactly the same ambitions as yourself!

451354.overview: A villainous wizard has captured a princess and imprisoned her in his castle. The king is not too happy with this and sends ten men in an attempt to rescue her. Castle Spellerous is an educational game that teaches children spelling. To rescue the princess the player has to spell a number of words right. Each word is shown on the screen briefly and the player has to memorize it and enter it correctly. By doing this the player constructs a tower piece by piece that ultimately will allow him to get into the castle. Answering wrong gives the wizard a chance to attack. He can then turn the player's men into either frogs, butterflies or bats or he can appear as a vampire bat and carry them away. The wizard can also do surprise attacks and then the player has to press the right key quickly to defend himself. The game is over when all the men have been lost. The player can choose between ten different levels of vocabulary, depending on difficulty and can also alter them to add words.

451851.overview:
You are a prisoner of the Third Reich… Can you escape it’s Iron Grip?

You stand alone in the heart of the most terrible P.O.W. prison of all. There is only one thought in your mind to escape. But you have no idea of which way to go. There are always several options open to you, each could mean a step nearer freedom or a confrontation with death…

The brutal Gestapo and SS Guards know that you are loose. They’ve set the dog’s onto you.

To escape from Castle Colditz you must survive such horrors as the corridor of Rats, the tunnel of Poisonous Spiders and the Vault of Human Bones.

452444.overview:
Chess or Psion Chess was developed for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum 48K by Psion Software Ltd, in collaboration with Mikro-Gen Ltd. The program featured:

.- High-resolution graphics for the chessboard and pieces
.- Ten levels of difficulty, with level 2 being a challenging opponent
.- Efficient machine code implementation

453071.overview:
Cup Football is a managerial game where you select an European team from a choice of 40 and try to take them all the way to a final of a cup and win it. After selecting your team you are shown your group which consists of eight groups made up of five teams, where you must qualify to get to the knock-out stages. You are presented afterwards with your stats and various options which include Squad, Bank, Bet, Transfer Market and next match details. Your squad can be changed around to match a required formation and you can also train the players individually but these can make them worse as well as better.

Bet allows you to bet on one of the upcoming matches and you have to predict the score. Transfer market allows you to look at various players that are available for buying as well as to sell players. Once you are happy with your selections you now watch the match in progress which is just text as a clock counts upwards and the major incidents are shown. You can make a sub or change tactics as the match is being played. After the game has finished you look at your expenses and your scout shows you the details of a player that can be brought as well as a team showing interest to buy one of your own players.

453097.overview:
Classic Punter gives you the chance to make your fortune and get rich by betting on the horses at a race meeting where you can select the number of races from 1 to 50. One or two players can play and bet with the aim of a one player game is to win £1,000,000 and a two player game is for one player to beat the other player. At the start of the game you are presented with your first race with a choice of horses and their odds. You can select a win bet or a forecast bet where a win bet allows you to bet on the winner while the forecast allows you to bet on the first and second place horses. After selecting your bet you can decide to pick S.P. odds which means the odds are fixed or Tote odds where the winning odds are given at the end of the race and can either be lower, higher or the same.

Once the bets are made then you can watch the race which is viewed from the side at an elevated angle with the screen scrolling from left to right. After the race the result is given and any money made or lost is shown. During the meeting between some races you can buy a tip with the more expensive tips having a better chance of being correct but there is no guarantee the horse will win. If you are low on money then you can get a loan but this will cost 10% weekly and 10% of your winnings are given to the lender. The game is over when either all the races have been run, your money reaches £1,000,000 or you lose it all.

453552.overview:
In the dark heart of the Cursed Castle, Sir Alaric, an unusual archer who despises the sword, strides forward with his bow held high, his arrows buzzing like echoes of hope in the gloom. Beside him is the eccentric Voktor, a mocking specter who turns fear into macabre laughter, and Osvald, a skeletal archer whose bones rattle with every step, marching like defiant shadows in a realm of darkness.

Closing ranks is the Executioner, a grim figure wielding his axe with ruthless strength, his heavy steps resonating like the echo of a sentence.

Together, this strange quartet faces deadly challenges and ancient creatures as dark magic trembles before them. Each battle unleashes a torrent of fury, and deep within, ultimate evil waits, knowing that these unexpected champions, with their courage and relentless bows, will not rest until they shoot their final arrow into the very heart of darkness.

453621.overview: Here i present a new game: "Chao Trouble", where an innocent Chao get lost into a huge box factory created by the evil Dr. Robotnik. The Chao must use his skills to jump, dodge, and crush the robots and creatures that guard the place, while looking for an exit.

455504.overview: Krazy Kong is based on the arcade game Donkey Kong where you have to move from the bottom of the screen to the top to rescue a Princess held by a giant ape. To move up the screen you have to climb ladders and move along platforms while avoiding or jumping barrels that roll down the platforms and ladders. There are also stars that move from the bottom of the screen and move upwards and if you touch a barrel or a star then you lose one of three lives. Later levels see moving platforms as well as spikes that shouldn't be landed on.

455954.overview:
A simple arcade game in which you have to steer your vehicle in such a way that you don't fall off the track.

Released as a type-in game in the book "Games for Your ZX Spectrum" in 1983, which was translated into several languages including German, Portuguese and had a release in The Netherlands.

456273.overview: Wee Knight must escape the haunted castle collecting gold coins and dodging the castles deadly inhabitants as he goes. Due to the enormous weight of his armor, Wee Knight cannot jump very high unless he consumes the magenta eggs found within the castle. But beware, the anti-gravity effects of the eggs do not last long leaving Wee Knight at risk of missing out on the castles many treasures. Prolong life by collecting the hearts and don’t let Wee Knight fall too far or he'll be crushed by the weight of his own armor.

457186.overview:
You are an "Un-named Protagonist". You could be anyone. You probably are anyone.

You've lived in Chump Town for many years, but things have been getting worse. Attitudes are changing. Sense is becoming less common. Logic seems illogical. It feels like there is an uprising coming; the general unrest in the unsatisfied and displeased population grows day by day. It's as if you cannot even buy an egg without taking out a bank loan any more.
